column2: WARNING: This file is to be opened and edited using a text editor. (e.g. Notepad/vi/emacs/Notepad++/VS Code)
Do NOT use a spreadsheet tool (e.g. Excel) to edit this file.
This file is tracked in git, do not modify unless you want to lose your changes.
Copy this file as custom.csv and edit it with your images instead.
Adding new images consists of two steps:
1. The image file being put into this directory. The image should be either a .png/.webp and of 180x180 pixels.
2. A line in a .csv file linking the file to a cXX ResourceName ID.
For ease of use, a template below has been prepared:
1. Choose a number you like (beginning from the lowest number, i.e. 10, is recommended). Go to the line that begins with "c" and your number (e.g. "c10").

2. Make sure the Filename (second column) is the same as the name of your image. This can be done by either saving the file as c10.png, or changing the line to be "c10,YourFileName.png,0,0,180,180" instead.
3. Enable the line by removing the "
